articles.title: After February grounding, Tejas fleet set to fly again today
articles.summary: India's indigenous Tejas Light Combat Aircraft (LCA) fleet is scheduled to resume flights today, after being grounded since February. This is a significant step for the Indian Air Force, reinstating the operational readiness of these domestically-built fighters. For SSB aspirants, this highlights India's commitment to self-reliance in defence manufacturing and strengthening its air power capabilities.

articles.title: Rohit Seksaria sees value in banking and services; trims exposure in metal, EMS stocks
articles.summary: Indian equity markets are currently facing significant turbulence. Rohit Seksaria, Fund Manager at Sundaram Mutual, is adopting a proactive strategy by repositioning investments rather than pulling back. In a recent conversation, he emphasized adapting portfolios to navigate market challenges and potentially capitalize on future opportunities amidst the volatility, showcasing a strategic approach to investment management in difficult times.

articles.title: How many people have been killed in the Iran war?
articles.summary: A conflict, referred to as the "Iran war," has led to thousands of fatalities across the Middle East. The hostilities commenced on February 28 with U.S. and Israeli strikes against Iran. These initial attacks subsequently triggered Iranian retaliatory strikes targeting Israel and U.S. assets, marking a significant escalation in regional tensions and military engagement.
